title: Append a Line to a File
question: Write Start to a file, append Finish on a new line, then print the contents.
code:
with open("log.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as file:
    file.write("Start\n")
with open("log.txt", "a", encoding="utf-8") as file:
    file.write("Finish\n")
with open("log.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8") as file:
    print(file.read(), end="")
explanation: Mode a appends text without replacing existing content.
